tricks: Drivers lean and look into turns; drift sparks change colour as the boost charges
A trick pose off every ramp edge, rewarded with a boost
Big full-body reactions when hit or passing someone, timed with voice lines
motion.lesson: Put the charge on the vehicle (spark colour) and the feeling on the driver (lean, trick pose, reaction).
